reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Participation of EUR 20 million in the EUR 300 million green bond issuance by Eesti Energia (the "Company" or the "Issuer"), with the bond to be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange's Euro MTF market. The issuance aims to support the Company's long-term energy transition strategy and its ongoing pipeline of investments in energy security related infrastructure. Proceeds will be allocated to Eligible Green Projects across the Company's core markets in Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland, as defined in the Green Finance Framework (the "Framework"), including: (i) investments in electricity transmission and distribution networks that enable renewable energy integration; (ii) renewable energy generation projects (wind and solar PV); (iii) battery energy storage systems; and (iv) electric vehicle charging infrastructure connected to the national grid (the "Project").
